name: sun-study-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `sunStudy` flag (pro tier — `ui/toolbar/menus/ToolsMenu.tsx` 'Sun study' row, wired to the local-state `useSunStudy` hook (`scene/sunStudy.ts` shape) that time-lapses `manualHour` dawn->dusk at ~1.4 sim-hours/real-second while active, restoring the prior time mode + hour on stop). Simple/Pro gate: the Tools menu itself is Pro-only at the mount level (Toolbar.tsx `{proMode && <ToolsMenu />}`), so this asserts the row's ABSENCE via the whole menu's absence in Simple and its presence + real effect in Pro — the same 'stronger, structural absence proof' pattern the batch-10 newBadges gotcha documents for another Pro-only menu. Real interaction: toggling Sun study on drives `manualHour` forward on its own (no user input needed) — verified by sampling the store value at two points in time and asserting the second reading is later on the 6-20h dawn->dusk band; toggling off restores the exact mode+hour it started from.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: assert-tools-menu-absent-in-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Tools'); if (btn) throw new Error('Tools menu trigger should not exist in the DOM in Simple mode (ToolsMenu is Pro-only at the mount level)') })()

steps.name: open-tools-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Tools'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Tools menu trigger should exist in Pro mode'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-tools-panel
steps.failMessage: the Sun study row should be present in the Tools menu (Review group) when sunStudy resolves on

steps.name: click-sun-study
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().startsWith('Sun study')); if (!b) throw new Error('Sun study row not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-hour-advanced
steps.comment: useSunStudy resets hour to a hardcoded dawn (6) the instant it activates, ignoring whatever manualHour was before (confirmed by reading scene/sunStudy.ts) -- so the real proof is (a) the hour jumped to the 6-20h dawn->dusk band regardless of the pre-toggle baseline of 13, and (b) it's still moving.
steps.eval: (() => { const h = window.__store.getState().manualHour; if (h < 6 || h > 20) throw new Error('sun study should land manualHour on the 6-20h dawn->dusk band, got ' + h); if (Math.abs(h - window.__sunBefore.hour) < 1e-3) throw new Error('sun study should have moved manualHour away from the pre-toggle baseline ' + window.__sunBefore.hour); window.__sunMid = h; })()

steps.name: assert-hour-kept-advancing
steps.eval: (() => { const h = window.__store.getState().manualHour; if (Math.abs(h - window.__sunMid) < 1e-3) throw new Error('sun study hour should keep advancing frame-over-frame, stuck at ' + h) })()

steps.name: click-sun-study-off
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().startsWith('Sun study')); if (!b) throw new Error('Sun study row not found (stop)'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-restored
steps.failMessage: stopping sun study should restore the exact prior time mode + hour

steps.name: assert-tools-menu-absent-again
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Tools'); if (btn) throw new Error('Tools menu should be gone again after switching back to Simple') })()
